text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim that driverless cars are \"a great advancement\"","quality":"explicit thesis","description":"The essay states a direct overall position early so the reader knows exactly what it is arguing."},{"evidence":"organized points on safety, disability access, time savings, and transporters","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay develops its argument in a more structured way by separating it into distinct supporting reasons."},{"evidence":"uses article-based claims like \"companies have been working on driverless cars for years\" and \"when needed to drive\"","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"The essay more consistently ties its claims to details from the article to support its position."},{"evidence":"explains how disabled people and busy workers would benefit","quality":"development of support","description":"The essay expands its reasons with concrete examples that show how the argument would work in real situations."},{"evidence":"concluding paragraph restates the position and main benefits","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends by summarizing the argument and reinforcing the central claim rather than stopping abruptly."}]}
